method: High-specificity heuristic credential signatures, no values printed; not proof of absence of every possible secret.

safety_review.model_deserialization: Only fixed trusted SHA256-checked original artifact; no upload or arbitrary pickle loading endpoint.
safety_review.application_rate_limiting: No authenticated per-user application limit; public free-tier denial-of-service/quota risk remains.
safety_review.headers: CSP self, DENY frames, nosniff; no secrets supplied to frontend.

runtime_policy: Only explicit independently verified CPython patches; scientific dependency pins unchanged. Provider patch selection is outside application control.
scope_note: All reachable Git refs plus every changed/new unignored file; high-specificity heuristics are not a proof against arbitrary secret formats.
